subject.title: [Feature]: Support for Custom Emojis in Latest Telegram Bot API Update

question: What public representation should Telegram custom emoji support use across the shared message tool, Markdown/presentation IR, Telegram channelData, and send/edit/caption paths?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent API shape affects plugin contracts, message-tool schema, Telegram transport behavior, fallback semantics, and future parse-mode work.

options.title: Add Telegram-owned entity fields
options.body: Expose validated `entities` and `caption_entities` through Telegram-owned message-tool/channelData surfaces and wire them through send/edit/caption paths with tests and fallback behavior.

options.title: Add shared custom emoji IR
options.body: Promote custom emoji into shared Markdown or presentation IR so Telegram can render it while other channels degrade explicitly.

options.title: Limit to raw HTML passthrough
options.body: Declare `<tg-emoji>`/rich HTML passthrough as the supported path for now and document that message-tool entity arrays remain unsupported.

recommendation.title: Add Telegram-owned entity fields
recommendation.body: Expose validated `entities` and `caption_entities` through Telegram-owned message-tool/channelData surfaces and wire them through send/edit/caption paths with tests and fallback behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest direct routing signal from the previous review of this exact issue and adjacent Telegram formatting decisions.
